product.title: Dark Luxury Instagram Breakthrough
product.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium, glossy, dark luxury Instagram post mockup in which the person from the uploaded photo is dramatically breaking through a realistic, physical Instagram card.

MAIN CONCEPT

The Instagram post should look like a real three-dimensional object made from premium paper and luxury materials, with the subject physically breaking through the surface.

The card should be:

* Slightly curved
* Thick and substantial
* Matte black
* Rounded at the corners
* Covered with subtle embossed details
* Enhanced with realistic paper fibers
* Finished with controlled glossy reflections
* Highly dimensional with realistic thickness and edges

Create a convincing torn-paper opening around the subject. The paper should appear physically ripped apart where the person’s body emerges, with realistic torn fibers, folds, creases, shadows, and raised edges.

SUBJECT

Replace the original character completely with the person from the uploaded photo.

Preserve their identity accurately and naturally.

Style the subject in:

* Matte-black bomber jacket
* Black T-shirt
* Black trousers
* Stainless-steel wristwatch
* Silver chain
* Black sunglasses

Keep the clothing sophisticated, minimal, and luxury-fashion inspired.

The subject should appear confident and dynamic while maintaining realistic anatomy.

3D BREAKOUT EFFECT

Make one arm extend naturally outside the torn Instagram card, reaching toward the viewer with convincing perspective.

The hand, arm, and body must be anatomically correct and proportionally consistent.

The other arm should remain partially inside the Instagram frame, reinforcing the illusion that the subject is physically emerging from the post.

The interaction between the body and paper must be physically believable — the torn edges should wrap naturally around the emerging body and cast realistic contact shadows.

INSTAGRAM INTERFACE

Create a sophisticated dark Instagram-style interface on the card.

Include:

* Instagram-style header
* Profile picture using the uploaded person’s face
* Username: dindu.creative
* Blue verified badge
* Three-dot menu
* Premium monochrome like, comment, share, and bookmark icons
* Dark interface styling
* Clean spacing and realistic UI hierarchy

At the bottom of the post, display exactly:

Design. Create. Inspire.

and:

#dinducreative

Keep the typography crisp, correctly spelled, and professionally aligned.

ENVIRONMENT

Place the entire composition against a luxurious deep-black background.

Add subtle atmospheric smoke around the card and subject without obscuring the face or interface.

Use:

* Soft cinematic spotlight
* Subtle amber rim lighting
* Deep controlled shadows
* Cinematic HDR illumination
* Realistic ambient occlusion
* Subtle volumetric atmosphere

The lighting should create separation between the black clothing, black card, and black background while retaining a sophisticated monochrome appearance.

MATERIAL & RENDERING

Make every material physically convincing:

* Ultra-realistic paper fibers
* Matte black paper
* Embossed details
* Glossy surfaces
* Stainless steel reflections
* Realistic sunglasses reflections
* Natural fabric texture
* Realistic skin texture
* Deep shadows
* Ray-traced reflections
* Accurate contact shadows
* Subtle highlights
* Photorealistic depth and perspective

The final result should resemble a high-budget luxury technology/fashion advertising campaign, combining premium product photography with conceptual 3D compositing.

ART DIRECTION

Aesthetic references:

Apple-style premium advertising + Behance/Dribbble showcase quality + luxury editorial photography + high-end 3D commercial design.

Keep the composition elegant, minimal, dramatic, and sophisticated.

Avoid a cheap CGI appearance. Everything should feel tactile, physical, expensive, and professionally art-directed.

IDENTITY PRESERVATION — CRITICAL

The uploaded photograph is the source of truth for the subject’s identity.

Preserve:

* Exact recognizable facial identity
* Facial structure
* Face shape
* Skin tone
* Eyes
* Nose
* Lips
* Jawline
* Beard/facial hair
* Hairstyle
* Natural facial proportions
* Overall recognizable appearance

Do not beautify, age, slim, masculinize, feminize, or otherwise alter the person’s identity.

The sunglasses must fit naturally without changing the underlying facial structure.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

cartoon, illustration, anime, generic model, different person, altered identity, distorted face, deformed face, blurry face, artificial facial features, excessive beauty retouching, plastic skin, incorrect anatomy, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands, extra limbs, duplicated body parts, warped arms, unnatural perspective, floating objects, broken paper physics, low-quality CGI, cheap mockup, flat lighting, excessive smoke, cluttered background, illegible text, misspelled text, incorrect username, random logos, random UI elements, watermark, A4 paper appearance, unrelated objects, low resolution, oversharpening, unnatural proportions.

Final objective: Create the illusion that the actual person in the uploaded photograph has physically broken through a premium, dark Instagram post card, while preserving their real identity and producing a polished, photorealistic, luxury advertising image.
